Computer engineer from the Military Institute of Engineering (IME) and MSc student in Applied Mathematics and Data Science at FGV EMAp. He worked as a data scientist at Open Co and as a research assistant at the Consiglio Nazionale delle Ricerche in Pisa.

## Education

- MSc in Applied Mathematics and Data Science — FGV EMAp, 2025–
- BSc in Computer Engineering — IME, 2020–2024

## Interests

Data science, machine learning, and computing.
